lessons.title: Was & were

sentences.english: Yesterday I was at the cinema.
Yesterday she was in a café.
The day before yesterday we were in the park.

sentences.target: Сначала я был в банке, потом в кафе.
sentences.english: First I was at the bank, then at a café.
sentences.translit: Snachala ya byl v banke, potom v kafe.

fills.english: Yesterday she was in a café.
Yesterday we were at the cinema.
She was in Italy last week.
First I was at the bank, then at a café.

dialogue.scene: A friend asks where you were

lessons.tip: Past = verb + -л. Был (he), была (she), было (it), были (they). Pick the ending by WHO did it: a woman says "я была".

lessons.title: Past verbs

sentences.english: Yesterday I worked in a café.
We watched a film in the evening.
I lived in Germany. (said by a woman)

fills.english: Yesterday she was reading a book.

dialogue.scene: A friend asks about your day

lines.english: I read and listened to music.

lessons.tip: Pattern: infinitive -ть becomes -л (he) or -ла (she). Работать → я работал / я работала. Your ending shows who you are, so a woman always adds -а.

lessons.title: Aspect pairs 1

items.english: to watch / to have a look

sentences.english: Yesterday I was reading a book.

lines.target: Отлично! А паспорт? Ты взял паспорт?
lines.english: Great! And your passport? Did you take it?
lines.translit: Otlichno! A pasport? Ty vzyal pasport?

lessons.tip: Most verbs come in pairs: imperfective = the process (читал = was reading), perfective = the result (прочитал = finished it). Want to say "I bought it"? Use купил.

lessons.title: Aspect pairs 2

items.english: to wait / to wait a bit

sentences.target: Я потерял телефон, но потом нашёл.
sentences.english: I lost my phone, but then I found it.
sentences.translit: Ya poteryal telefon, no potom nashyol.

sentences.english: I opened the door and left.

fills.english: I lost my phone, but then I found it.

lines.english: Hi! Did you find the key?

replyOptions: Не знаю. Может быть, в метро.

lessons.tip: A perfective verb has no "now": it means done (past) or will do (future). So you can't say "я прочитаю" about right now. Past: нашёл. Imperfective for repeating: находил.

lessons.title: My day

items.english: in the morning I got up

sentences.english: In the morning I got up and had breakfast.
Then I set off to work.
I had lunch at a café.
In the evening I came back home.

sentences.target: Я очень устал и лёг спать.
sentences.english: I got really tired and went to bed.
sentences.translit: Ya ochen' ustal i lyog spat'.

fills.english: First I had breakfast, then I set off to work.
In the evening she came back home.

dialogue.scene: Telling a friend about your day

lines.target: Всё было хорошо. Я очень устал.
lines.english: Everything was fine. I got really tired.
lines.translit: Vsyo bylo khorosho. Ya ochen' ustal.

lessons.tip: To tell a story, chain perfective past verbs: встал, позавтракал, поехал. Each one is a finished step, one after another. Add сначала / потом / наконец and you're telling your day.

lessons.title: Trip words

sentences.english: I want to go on holiday.
My grandma lives in a village.

fills.english: My grandma lives in a village.

lines.target: Ты хочешь на море или на озеро?
lines.english: Do you want the sea or a lake?
lines.translit: Ty khochesh' na more ili na ozero?

lessons.tip: "In a place" takes -е: в городе, в деревне, на пляже. Don't analyse it yet, just learn "в + place" as chunks: в городе, на море.

lessons.title: The hotel

sentences.target: Мне нужен одноместный номер на три ночи.
sentences.english: I need a single room for three nights.
sentences.translit: Mne nuzhen odnomestnyy nomer na tri nochi.

sentences.english: How much is a double room?
Please give me the room key.
Is there air conditioning in the room?

fills.english: I need a room for three nights.
How much is a double room?

lines.target: Добрый вечер! У вас есть бронь?
lines.english: Good evening! Do you have a booking?
lines.translit: Dobryy vecher! U vas yest' bron'?

lines.target: Да, у меня есть бронь на три ночи.
lines.english: Yes, I have a booking for three nights.
lines.translit: Da, u menya yest' bron' na tri nochi.

replyOptions: Нет, спасибо, я не хочу кофе.

lessons.tip: Length of stay = на + number: на три ночи (for three nights). Remember it whole. After три / два / четыре the noun ends -и: ночи.

lessons.title: At the airport

sentences.english: I want to go to the airport.

sentences.target: У меня есть билет на самолёт и паспорт.
sentences.english: I have a plane ticket and a passport.
sentences.translit: U menya yest' bilet na samolyot i pasport.

sentences.english: It's a delay, not a cancellation.

fills.english: I want to go to the airport.
It's a delay, not a cancellation.

lessons.tip: At vs to: в аэропорту = at the airport; в аэропорт = to the airport. A one-letter change tells you if you're staying or moving. (аэропорт is one of the few that takes -у, not -е.)

lessons.title: Sightseeing

sentences.english: It's stunning, I need a postcard.

lines.english: Hi! Did you see the cathedral?
And the castle? Want to see it?

lessons.tip: Pointing at things? Это + noun, no verb needed: Это замок. Это собор. "This is a castle." Same pattern for everything you see.

lessons.title: Car & rentals

sentences.english: I want to rent a car.
I need petrol. Where's the petrol station?
The sat nav says: straight on.

fills.english: The sat nav says: straight on.
I want to rent a car.

lines.target: Добрый день! У вас есть права?
lines.english: Good afternoon! Do you have a driving licence?
lines.translit: Dobryy den'! U vas yest' prava?

lines.english: Fine. Do you want a sat nav?

lessons.tip: Drive verbs are tricky, so for now use one chunk: я еду = I'm going (by vehicle). Я еду в аэропорт. The full set of "go" verbs comes later.

lessons.title: Booking

sentences.english: I want to book a doctor's appointment.
Can we move it to tomorrow?
I want to cancel my booking.
Do you have any free time?

fills.english: I want to book a doctor's appointment.
Can we move it to tomorrow?
I want to cancel my booking.

lines.english: Hello! Do you want to book in?
Yes, to see the doctor, please.

lessons.tip: Sign up "to" a person = к + dative: к врачу (to the doctor). Learn it as a chunk: записаться к врачу. Booking times: на завтра, на пять.

lessons.title: The body

sentences.target: У меня есть две руки и две ноги.
sentences.english: I have two hands and two legs.
sentences.translit: U menya yest' dve ruki i dve nogi.

lines.target: Он высокий! И у него красивые глаза.
lines.english: He's tall! And he has beautiful eyes.
lines.translit: On vysokiy! I u nevo krasivyye glaza.

lines.target: Да! А у тебя есть брат?
lines.english: Yes! And do you have a brother?
lines.translit: Da! A u tebya yest' brat?

lessons.tip: Body-part plurals are irregular, so learn them as pairs: глаз → глаза, ухо → уши, рука → руки, зуб → зубы. Pair them with У меня / У него.

lessons.title: I feel ill

items.english: I have a pain in… (it hurts)

sentences.english: I caught a cold: cough and runny nose.
I feel bad, I feel sick.

sentences.target: Мне больно, у меня болит спина.
sentences.translit: Mne bol'no, u menya bolit spina.

dialogue.scene: A friend notices you look rough
replyOptions: Нет, но у меня кашель и насморк.

lessons.tip: Pain pattern: У меня болит + thing. The thing that hurts is the subject, so it can change: болит голова, болят зубы (plural). No "my" needed; "у меня" already says whose.

lessons.title: At the doctor

sentences.english: How often should I take the pills?
Take it three times a day.

fills.english: Take it three times a day.

lines.target: У меня болит горло и температура.
lines.english: My throat hurts and I have a temperature.
lines.translit: U menya bolit gorlo i temperatura.

lines.target: Вот рецепт. Принимать три раза в день.
lines.english: Here's a prescription. Take it three times a day.
lines.translit: Vot retsept. Prinimat' tri raza v den'.

lessons.tip: Dose is a ready-made chunk: принимать три раза в день (take three times a day). Swap the number: два раза, один раз. Doctors speak in infinitives, so it's easy.

lessons.title: Paperwork

sentences.english: A signature and a stamp are needed here.
I want to fill in the form.
Is this the queue? Take a ticket.

sentences.target: Где почта? У меня посылка и письмо.
sentences.english: Where is the post office? I have a parcel and a letter.
sentences.translit: Gde pochta? U menya posylka i pis'mo.

fills.english: I want to fill in the form.
A signature and a stamp are needed here.

lines.english: Here's the form. Can you fill it in?

lessons.tip: To fill something in: заполнить + object. A feminine object changes -а to -у: анкета → анкету, справка → справку. Say заполнить анкету as one chunk and move on.

lessons.title: Weather nouns

sentences.target: Вчера был мороз, а сегодня снег.
sentences.english: Yesterday it was freezing, and today it's snowing.
sentences.translit: Vchera byl moroz, a sevodnya sneg.

lessons.tip: Weather talk is mostly plain nouns: Сегодня дождь. Завтра гроза. In the past just add был / была: вчера был дождь, вчера была жара. In солнце the first л is silent: "sontse".

lessons.title: What's it like?

sentences.english: The sun is shining and it's warm.

lines.english: What's it like where you are?

lines.target: А у нас тепло! Светит солнце.
lines.english: We have warm weather! The sun is shining.
lines.translit: A u nas teplo! Svetit solntse.

lessons.tip: Weather needs no subject: Холодно. Тепло. Мне холодно. Past: было холодно. These -о words (холодно, тепло, жарко) are the Russian "it's cold / it's warm". Идёт дождь = rain "goes".

lessons.title: Seasons

sentences.english: It's warm in summer and the sun shines.
In autumn it's cloudy and windy.

lines.english: No, it's very cold in winter.

replyOptions: Лето я люблю! Тепло и солнце.

lessons.tip: "In winter" = зимой, "in summer" = летом: the -ой / -ом / -ью ending is the "in season" form. No preposition needed. Learn the four as a set: зимой, весной, летом, осенью.

lessons.title: Nature & animals

sentences.target: В деревне есть лошадь и корова.
sentences.english: There's a horse and a cow in the village.
sentences.translit: V derevne yest' loshad' i korova.

fills.english: There's a cow in the village.

lessons.tip: Living things take -у: я вижу собаку, я вижу кошку. A feminine animal ending -а becomes -у when you SEE it. Learn it as "вижу + собаку" and it will stick.

lessons.title: Where? В and на
lessons.tip: Location = в / на + -е: в городе, в доме, на улице, на вокзале. Mostly в; на for open spaces, events, and compass points (на севере). Learn each as a chunk and trust your ear.

lessons.title: The future of быть

sentences.english: Will you be at the café?
We'll be here in an hour.

sentences.target: Они будут в Италии на следующей неделе.
sentences.english: They'll be in Italy next week.
sentences.translit: Oni budut v Italii na sleduyushchey nedele.

sentences.english: It'll be hot the day after tomorrow.

fills.english: Will you be at the café?
We'll be here in an hour.

lessons.tip: Future of быть: я буду, ты будешь, он будет, мы будем, вы будете, они будут. Think "will be". Add a time word (завтра, через час) and you can plan anything.

lessons.title: Future verbs

sentences.english: I'll think about it, then I'll tell you.

fills.english: First I'll think, then I'll say.

lines.english: Fine! And who'll make the soup?

lessons.tip: A perfective verb in the present form means the future: я позвоню (I'll call), я куплю (I'll buy). No "will" word needed. Want a process instead? Use буду + infinitive: я буду работать.

lessons.title: Intentions

items.english: I'm going to, I intend to

sentences.english: I'm going to work in Germany.
I want to become a doctor.

sentences.target: У меня есть идея и цель.
sentences.english: I have an idea and a goal.
sentences.translit: U menya yest' ideya i tsel'.

fills.english: I want to become a doctor.

replyOptions: Нет, в Испании. Это моя мечта.

lessons.tip: "I'm going to" = я собираюсь + infinitive: я собираюсь работать. "I want to become" = я хочу стать (+ job in -ом: врачом). Both take an infinitive, no conjugating the second verb.

lessons.title: Suggestions

sentences.english: I suggest going to the cinema.

sentences.target: К сожалению не могу, в другой раз.
sentences.translit: K sozhaleniyu ne mogu, v drugoy raz.

fills.english: I suggest going to the cinema.

lines.target: У меня идея! Как насчёт кино?
lines.english: I have an idea! How about the cinema?
lines.translit: U menya ideya! Kak naschyot kino?

lessons.tip: Suggest with Давайте + verb (let's): Давайте встретимся. Or как насчёт + noun (how about…): Как насчёт кофе? Reply with chunks: С удовольствием! / К сожалению не могу.

lessons.title: Plans for the year

sentences.target: В следующем году я хочу выучить язык.
sentences.english: Next year I want to learn a language.
sentences.translit: V sleduyushchem godu ya khochu vyuchit' yazyk.

sentences.english: I'm planning to find a job.
I'm going to buy a flat.
She wants to move to England.
He wants to go to Russia.

sentences.target: Я хочу накопить деньги и открыть бизнес.
sentences.english: I want to save money and start a business.
sentences.translit: Ya khochu nakopit' den'gi i otkryt' biznes.

fills.english: I'm planning to find a job.
He wants to go to Russia.
I'm going to buy a flat.

lines.target: Что ты планируешь в следующем году?
lines.english: What are you planning for next year?
lines.translit: Shto ty planiruyesh' v sleduyushchem godu?

lines.target: Я хочу выучить язык и найти работу.
lines.english: I want to learn a language and find a job.
lines.translit: Ya khochu vyuchit' yazyk i nayti rabotu.

lines.target: А ты хочешь поехать в Россию?
lines.english: And do you want to go to Russia?
lines.translit: A ty khochesh' poyekhat' v Rossiyu?

lessons.tip: After хочу / планирую / собираюсь the second verb stays in the infinitive, usually perfective because you want a result: хочу выучить, планирую найти, собираюсь купить.
